articles.summary: Indian para-athletes achieved their best ever performance at the Asian Para Games by securing a record-shattering haul of 114 medals in total. This historic collection included 30 gold medals, following an impressive flourish on the final day of the competition. The exceptional results surpassed all prior expectations for the national team, marking a major milestone for Indian sports.

articles.title: Reserve Bank of India Tightens Operational Risk Capital Norms for Banks
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has revised operational risk capital norms for banks. The new rules cover income classification, derivative valuations, and historical loss data. They become effective on April 1, 2027. Under the financial component, banks must separately classify gains and losses from trading book and banking book activities in line with regulatory directions.

articles.title: French bond selloff raises debt concerns across Europe amid social unrest
articles.summary: European bond markets have stabilised following a volatile week of trading. However, a persistent French bond selloff is raising fresh debt concerns across the continent amid ongoing social unrest. This development highlights continued fragility in regional financial stability as investors closely monitor sovereign debt levels and broader economic conditions in European markets.

articles.title: Actor RJ Mitte Known For Breaking Bad Passes Away At Age 34
articles.summary: Actor RJ Mitte, who played Walter White Junior in the television show Breaking Bad, has died at the age of thirty-four. Authorities reportedly identified his death as suicide. Bryan Cranston shared an emotional tribute to his former on-screen son. Mitte was diagnosed with cerebral palsy as a child and used his platform to champion disability awareness and inclusion.

articles.title: Vadodara Civic Body Approves Controversial Land Plot Transfer to Yusuf Pathan
articles.summary: The Vadodara Municipal Corporation standing committee approved transferring a residential plot to former cricketer and Member of Parliament Yusuf Pathan on Friday. Congress workers protested the decision in Gujarat, calling it an unfair distribution of public property. Pathan will receive part of the land as a gift and pay for the rest at a concessional rate.

articles.title: Foreign Funding Behind Protests: Political Bogey Or National Security Threat
articles.summary: On India Today's Democratic Newsroom, anchor Preeti Choudhary leads an editorial debate with journalists Rajdeep Sardesai, Gaurav Sawant, Pooja Shali, and Akshita on allegations of foreign funding and external interference in domestic protests across India. articles.title: Affiliate urges Centre to deny Starlink licence on security grounds
articles.summary: The Swadeshi Jagran Manch urged the central government in New Delhi on Friday to deny a commercial licence to Elon Musk-owned Starlink. Officials are examining the system to ensure regulatory compliance and public safety.

articles.title: India rewrite Asian Para Games record, but not every sport keeps pace
articles.summary: India finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya with a record 114 medals, surpassing the country's previous best at the continental event. The final tally of 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals bettered India's 2023 performance in Hangzhou, when the contingent officially finished with 108 medals after three medals were later stripped following doping violations.
articles.title_hi: भारत ने एशियाई पैरा खेलों का रिकॉर्ड फिर से लिखा, लेकिन हर खेल गति बनाए नहीं रखता
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने आइची-नागोया में 2026 एशियाई पैरा खेलों को रिकॉर्ड 114 पदकों के साथ समाप्त किया, जो महाद्वीपीय आयोजन में देश के पिछले सर्वश्रेष्ठ से आगे निकल गया। 30 स्वर्ण, 35 रजत और 49 कांस्य पदकों की अंतिम तालिका ने हांग्जो में भारत के 2023 के प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बना दिया, जब डोपिंग उल्लंघन के बाद तीन पदक छीन लिए जाने के बाद दल आधिकारिक तौर पर 108 पदकों के साथ समाप्त हुआ।

articles.title: Manoj Kumar Jha Examines Constitutional Erosion and Cruelty in India
articles.summary: Analysing modern majoritarianism, author Manoj Kumar Jha evaluates how political cruelty and institutional erosion threaten constitutional morality in India. Drawing on Alan Wolfe, the essay highlights how punitive demolitions and state indifference normalise suffering among vulnerable populations. Observers warn that electoral mandates cannot replace foundational democratic restraints or diminish the equal rights of all citizens under the rule of law.

Referring to the circumstances that led to the controversy amid public pressure, Dhami said the minister had issued a statement clarifying that he had no such intention.
articles.title_hi: दलेर मेहंदी प्रदर्शन विवाद पर उत्तराखंड के मुख्यमंत्री धामी

articles.title_hinglish: dalera mehandi pradarshana vivada para uttarakhanda ke mukhyamantri dhami
articles.summary_hinglish: rachanatmaka vyaktitvon aura sanskritika hastiyon ka sammana karane ki rajya ki paranpara ko rekhankita karate hue mukhyamantri ne kah, "ye sabhi pratishthita kalakara hain। uttarakhanda eka aisi bhumi hai jo lekhakon, kalakaron aura vidvanon ka samana rupa se sammana karati hai।" janata ke dabava ke bicha vivada ki vajaha bani paristhitiyon ka jikra karate hue dhami ne kaha ki mantri ne eka bayana jari kara spashta kiya tha ki unaka aisa koee irada nahin tha।

articles.title: Former Tamil Nadu BJP Chief Annamalai Targets Old Party
articles.summary: Former Bharatiya Janata Party state president K Annamalai has launched relentless attacks against his former political party in Tamil Nadu. Analysts suggest the strategy aims to shed his proxy tag and boost his new We The Leaders movement before upcoming local elections. However, experts warn the aggressive shift could risk alienating key supporters who backed his previous association.

articles.title: Actor RJ Mitte and Designer Sahara Ray Both Pass Away at Age Thirty-Four
articles.summary: Model and swimwear designer Sahara Ray has died at age thirty-four at a hospital surrounded by loved ones. Her family confirmed the news following her previous battle with Guillain-Barre syndrome. Meanwhile, actor RJ Mitte, known for playing Walter White Junior in Breaking Bad, has also died at age thirty-four from a reported suicide.
articles.title_hi: अभिनेता आरजे मिट्टे और डिजाइनर सहारा रे दोनों का चौंतीस साल की उम्र में निधन हो गया
articles.summary_hi: मॉडल और स्विमवियर डिजाइनर सहारा रे का चौंतीस साल की उम्र में प्रियजनों के बीच एक अस्पताल में निधन हो गया। गुइलेन-बैरी सिंड्रोम से उनकी पिछली लड़ाई के बाद उनके परिवार ने इस खबर की पुष्टि की। इस बीच, ब्रेकिंग बैड में वाल्टर व्हाइट जूनियर की भूमिका निभाने के लिए जाने जाने वाले अभिनेता आरजे मिट्टे की भी कथित आत्महत्या से चौंतीस साल की उम्र में मृत्यु हो गई है।
articles.title_hinglish: abhineta aaraje mitte aura dijainara sahara re donon ka chauntisa sala ki umra men nidhana ho gaya
articles.summary_hinglish: modala aura svimaviyara dijainara sahara re ka chauntisa sala ki umra men priyajanon ke bicha eka aspatala men nidhana ho gaya। guilena-bairi sindroma se unaki pichhali ladaाee ke bada unake parivara ne isa khabara ki pushti ki। isa bich, brekinga baida men valtara vhaita juniyara ki bhumika nibhane ke lie jane jane vale abhineta aaraje mitte ki bhi kathita aatmahatya se chauntisa sala ki umra men mrityu ho gaee hai।

articles.title: Mumbai Police Seal Hotel Room Linked To Tiger Shroff Firing Investigation
articles.summary: The Mumbai Crime Branch has sealed an Andheri hotel room where three key suspects in the Tiger Shroff firing case allegedly stayed. Investigators are examining the location as part of the ongoing probe into the incident. The authorities have restricted access to the room to gather crucial evidence and advance their inquiry.
articles.title_hi: मुंबई पुलिस ने टाइगर श्रॉफ फायरिंग जांच से जुड़ा होटल का कमरा सील किया

articles.title_hinglish: munbaee pulisa ne taigara shropha phayaringa jancha se judaा hotala ka kamara sila kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: munbaee kraima brancha ne andheri ke eka hotala ke kamare ko sila kara diya hai, jahan taigara shropha phayaringa mamale ke tina pramukha sandigdha kathita taura para ruke the। ghatana ki chala rahi jancha ke tahata janchakarta sthana ki jancha kara rahe hain। adhikariyon ne mahatvapurna sabuta ikattha karane aura apani jancha ko aage badhaाne ke lie kamare taka pahuncha pratibandhita kara di hai।

articles.title: Sikkim CM attends Om Prakash Mathur’s swearing-in as Keralam governor

articles.summary_hinglish: soshala midiya posta men mathura ko unaki naee jimmedari ke lie badhaee dete hue tamanga ne vishvasa jataya ki unaka prashasanika anubhava aura sarvajanika seva unhen apani jimmedariyon ko prabhavi dhanga se nibhane men madada karegi। unhonne mathura ke saphala karyakala ki kamana karate hue aasha vyakta ki ki unaka netritva keralama ke logon ki pragati, samriddhi aura kalyana men yogadana dega।

articles.title: New report outlines strategies to strengthen the sports ecosystem in India
articles.summary: A recent strategic report outlines key measures to accelerate sports growth, improve infrastructure, and enhance elite athlete performance across India. articles.title: Indian Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Report Improved Business Conditions
articles.summary: A new report by the Small Industries Development Bank of India reveals that business confidence among micro, small and medium enterprises rose to sixty point four in the second quarter of fiscal year twenty twenty seven. Nearly half of the firms reported better conditions across manufacturing, services and trading sectors, with expectations strengthening for the coming quarters.

articles.title: India's forex reserves decline $5 billion to $721 billion: RBI data
articles.summary: India's forex reserves dropped by $5. 011 billion to $721. 016 billion during the week ended October 16, the Reserve Bank of India said on Friday. In the previous reporting week, the kitty declined by $8. 578 billion to $726. 027 billion. The reserves touched an all-time high of $785.
articles.title_hi: भारत का विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार 5 अरब डॉलर घटकर 721 अरब डॉलर रह गया: आरबीआई डेटा
articles.summary_hi: भारत का विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार 5 डॉलर गिरा। 011 बिलियन से $721। 16 अक्टूबर को समाप्त सप्ताह के दौरान 016 बिलियन, भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक ने शुक्रवार को कहा। पिछले रिपोर्टिंग सप्ताह में, किटी में $8 की गिरावट आई थी। 578 बिलियन से 726 डॉलर। 027 अरब. भंडार $785 के सर्वकालिक उच्चतम स्तर को छू गया।

articles.title: E-mail warns of bomb blast at Diljit Dosanjh’s Mumbai concert on November 27
articles.summary: Close on the heels of the shootout at Tiger Shroff that shook Mumbai recently, an e-mail warning of multiple bomb blasts in the city — including at the November 27 concert of popular Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh in the Mahalaxmi Racecourse area — has put the authorities on high alert.

articles.title: Kerala High Court refuses to stay State decision to reconstitute Waqf Board

articles.title_hi: केरल उच्च न्यायालय ने वक्फ बोर्ड के पुनर्गठन के राज्य के फैसले पर रोक लगाने से इनकार कर दिया

articles.title: No engineering degree, 13 years of learning: Uttarakhand man builds flying car
articles.summary: Ravi Tamta, a Bachelor of Arts graduate from Uttarakhand’s Almora district, has built an electric flying car prototype after 13 years of learning through online resources and hands-on experiments, despite having no formal science or engineering education. His single-seater vehicle, HAPIDA SKYNeX, completed a test flight in August, highlighting how self-directed learning can help people explore ideas beyond the classroom.

articles.title: Kerala HC Division Bench refuses to stay reconstitution of State Waqf Board
articles.summary: The appeals were filed by former board chairperson K. S. Hamza and member C. K. Usman Haji. The court held that an interim stay could not be granted, as the new Waqf Board had taken charge. The court directed the petitioners to issue notice to the current board members. articles.title: Delhi Sports Minister Ashish Sood inaugurates 70th National School Games
articles.summary: Advertisement The Government of Delhi will organise 14 sports disciplines under the 70th National School Games 2026–27 in three phases. The first phase will be held from 22 to 28 October 2026, the second phase from 30 October to 5 November 2026, and the third phase from 28 January to 3 February 2027, according to a release.

articles.title: Parvinder Awana appointed chairman of BCCI junior selection committee
articles.summary: "The Cricket Advisory Committee (CAC) conducted a selection process for the appointment of members to the Junior Cricket Committee. articles.title: Business confidence rebounds in Q2 after four quarters of moderation: NCAER
articles.summary: India's business confidence improved in the second quarter of FY27, reversing four consecutive quarters of moderation, as firms turned more optimistic about economic conditions, sales and investment ahead of the festive season, according to a survey by the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER). The Business Confidence Index (BCI) rose to 107.

articles.title: Delhi SEM Court Summons: Leaders Appear At Mandir Marg Amid Crime Branch Probe
articles.summary: Leaders Sourav Das and Ashutosh Shankar appeared before the Special Executive Magistrate court at Mandir Marg Police Station in New Delhi following court summons. Accompanied by their legal team, the individuals attended the hearing as mandated during their earlier release conditions. The development follows an earlier seven-day period spent in Tihar Jail, served across initial five-day and subsequent two-day detentions.
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली एसईएम कोर्ट समन: अपराध शाखा की जांच के बीच नेता मंदिर मार्ग पर पेश हुए
articles.summary_hi: अदालत के समन के बाद नेता सौरव दास और आशुतोष शंकर नई दिल्ली के मंदिर मार्ग पुलिस स्टेशन में विशेष कार्यकारी मजिस्ट्रेट अदालत में पेश हुए। अपनी कानूनी टीम के साथ, व्यक्तियों ने अपनी पिछली रिहाई शर्तों के दौरान अनिवार्य रूप से सुनवाई में भाग लिया। यह घटनाक्रम तिहाड़ जेल में बिताए गए पहले सात दिनों की अवधि, शुरुआती पांच दिनों और उसके बाद दो दिनों की नजरबंदी के बाद का है।

articles.title: Swimwear Designer And Model Sahara Ray Dies At Age 34
articles.summary: Model and swimwear designer Sahara Ray has died at the age of thirty four at a hospital surrounded by loved ones. Her family confirmed the heartbreaking news to the media outlet TMZ. Ray built a following through social media and launched her own label. Her cause of death has not been officially confirmed by authorities.

articles.title: Jammu Kashmir Govt Orders Transfers, Postings in Food and Civil Supplies Department
articles.summary: SRINAGAR : The Jammu and Kashmir Government has ordered the transfer and posting of three officers in the Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs with immediate effect. According to Government Order No. 97-JK(FCS&CA) of 2026, issued on October 23, Khalil Ahmed, Assistant Director, Poonch, has been assigned the additional charge of Assistant Director, Rajouri, alongside his existing duties.

articles.title: 100+ Japanese companies expand GCC operations in India, report finds
articles.summary: More than 100 Japanese companies have established or expanded Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in India , with operations increasingly focused on artificial intelligence (AI), engineering, product development and cybersecurity, according to a report by real estate services firm Cushman & Wakefield . The expansion reflects a shift in how Japanese businesses use their Indian operations.

articles.title: Zoho cofounder Sridhar Vembu says India must build using local talent
articles.summary: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu stated on social media that India will only earn global respect by developing through its own domestic talent. Responding to mathematician Eric Weinstein regarding rising online hostility toward Indians, Vembu emphasized that focusing on national development is the ultimate response to criticism. He urged citizens to prioritize building the nation successfully.

articles.title: Congress demands answers from government on China border tensions and trade
articles.summary: On Friday, senior Congress leaders urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to clarify reports of border face-offs with China in Arunachal Pradesh. Leaders questioned whether military patrolling access has changed and expressed concern over a widening bilateral trade deficit. articles.title: Citizen Justice Party Leaders Visit Delhi Police Station Over Jantar Mantar Protest
articles.summary: Citizen Justice Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ajinkya Shinde arrived at Mandir Marg Police Station in Delhi for questioning. The Delhi Police Crime Branch summoned them regarding an October 13 protest at Jantar Mantar where members allegedly trespassed and obstructed officials after the site was de-notified. Ranka and Das recently were released from judicial custody.
articles.title_hi: जंतर मंतर विरोध को लेकर सिटीजन जस्टिस पार्टी के नेताओं ने दिल्ली पुलिस स्टेशन का दौरा किया
articles.summary_hi: सिटीजन जस्टिस पार्टी के नेता आशुतोष रांका, सौरव दास और अजिंक्य शिंदे पूछताछ के लिए दिल्ली के मंदिर मार्ग पुलिस स्टेशन पहुंचे। दिल्ली पुलिस अपराध शाखा ने उन्हें जंतर-मंतर पर 13 अक्टूबर के विरोध प्रदर्शन के संबंध में तलब किया था, जहां सदस्यों ने साइट को गैर-अधिसूचित किए जाने के बाद कथित तौर पर अतिक्रमण किया था और अधिकारियों के काम में बाधा डाली थी। रांका और दास को हाल ही में न्यायिक हिरासत से रिहा किया गया था।
articles.title_hinglish: jantara mantara virodha ko lekara sitijana jastisa parti ke netaon ne dilli pulisa steshana ka daura kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: sitijana jastisa parti ke neta aashutosha rank, saurava dasa aura ajinkya shinde puchhatachha ke lie dilli ke mandira marga pulisa steshana pahunche। dilli pulisa aparadha shakha ne unhen jantara-mantara para 13 aktubara ke virodha pradarshana ke sanbandha men talaba kiya th, jahan sadasyon ne saita ko gaira-adhisuchita kie jane ke bada kathita taura para atikramana kiya tha aura adhikariyon ke kama men badha dali thi। ranka aura dasa ko hala hi men nyayika hirasata se riha kiya gaya tha।

articles.title: India Steps Up Indigenous Telecom Research As C-DOT Establishes 6G, AI Centre At IIT
articles.summary: According to a Ministry of Communications release issued on Friday (23 October), C-DOT and IIT BHU signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to facilitate collaborative research, technology development and capacity building in emerging telecommunications technologies. The centre will focus on 5G Advanced and 6G technologies , artificial intelligence-driven communication systems, quantum and post-quantum communications, cybersecurity and advanced wireless networks.

articles.summary_hinglish: shukravara (23 aktubara) ko jari sanchara mantralaya ki eka vijnyapti ke anusar, si-dota aura aaeeaaeeti biechayu ne ubharati durasanchara praudyogikiyon men sahayogatmaka anusandhan, praudyogiki vikasa aura kshamata nirmana ki suvidha ke lie eka samajhauta jnyapana (emaoyu) para hastakshara kie। kendra 5ji unnata aura 6ji praudyogikiyon, kritrima buddhimatta-sanchalita sanchara pranaliyon, kvantama aura posta-kvantama sanchar, saibara suraksha aura unnata vayaralesa netavarka para dhyana kendrita karega।

articles.title: Punjab polls: Badal praises SAD-BJP rule as Amit Shah’s NDA pitch fuels reunion buzz
articles.summary: Speculation over a possible reunion between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) gathered pace on Friday after SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal said his party was open to an alliance with parties that agree with its ideology and programmes, a day after Union home minister Amit Shah predicted an NDA government in Punjab in 2027.

articles.title: BREAKING: Swadeshi Jagran Manch Demands Ban on Starlink, Citing National Security Concerns
articles.summary: The RSS-affiliated Swadeshi Jagran Manch (SJM) has announced a protest in Delhi as it intensifies its campaign against Starlink’s proposed commercial rollout. SJM has urged the Centre to deny Starlink permission to operate, citing concerns over national security, data routing, lawful monitoring and the government’s ability to restrict internet connectivity during emergencies and law-and-order situations.
